//==
// ## Primaries, transfer functions, and RGB color spaces

// An opto-electronic transfer characteristic: how linear light is encoded to
// (and decoded from) stored component values. SRGB is the piecewise sRGB
// curve; Rec709 is the BT.1886 pair; PQ (SMPTE ST 2084) and HLG (hybrid
// log-gamma) are the HDR encodings.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transfer_functions_in_imaging)
type TransferFunction
    = Linear | SRGB | Gamma18 | Gamma22 | Gamma24 | Gamma26 | Rec709 | PQ | HLG;
